content.comment_body: Hello, based on earlier discussions, the guest account should be limited to viewing only and shouldn't be able to make changes or interact with buttons. However, when I access the web interface as either a guest or a user, both seem to have the same permissions and can operate the buttons on the default web interface for the [product_name] screen. Is there an extra setting required to activate a true view-only mode for the guest account? My goal is to establish an actual read-only mode where all buttons are disabled for guests and no changes can be made, but it seems this functionality might not be available by default.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes a usability issue with the default web interface configuration: both guest and user accounts have equal access and can interact with buttons, which should be restricted for guest logins. The user is uncertain whether more configuration is needed to enable guest-specific view-only access and suspects this option may not be provided out of the box.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the ability to configure a genuine view-only mode for guests, where no controls are active and changes cannot be made during guest access.
